fieldNotes.siteIdentification: 1420 Delmar Drive, Folcroft PA 19032 - listed on crowley.com/locations as Crowley's Pennsylvania warehouse / receiving location (operated with CMS Transportation Inc.). Geocoded ROOFTOP to a single large dark-roofed warehouse building confirmed in satellite z18-z20. The large rows of light-roofed buildings immediately east across Delmar Drive are a self-storage facility, NOT part of the Crowley site.
fieldNotes.yardSpotsMeaning: trailerParkingCapacity is TRAILER PARKING (not container slots): the unpaved gravel/dirt drop yard on the NW side plus the south apron. ~8 trailers/containers visible parked in the gravel row in z18; conservative capacity ~25 if striped/stacked. Low confidence - unpaved lot, no painted stalls.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or guard booth resolved in imagery; the property is a small infill industrial lot wedged into a residential block. Street View coverage exists only on the surrounding residential streets (Delmar Dr cul-de-sac), which show houses, not a controlled truck entrance. Truck access appears to be an open driveway at the south/SE corner off Delmar Drive. Set truckGate=false (open driveway, no visible control) but flagged uncertain - the yard side is not Street-View visible.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible. No gate, so remoteGs is also false.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: The lot is hemmed in by single-family homes on the east and south and a residential cul-de-sac; truck maneuvering room is tight and a queue would back onto a residential street. Flagged backup-sensitive.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South/SE apron shows a short bank of dock positions (estimated ~6, band 0-10). Partly shadowed by tree canopy in summer imagery - low confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short approach from Delmar Drive to the building apron; holds only 1-2 trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Folcroft is inside the dense Philadelphia metro fabric (Delaware County, ~8 mi SW of Center City) - Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into this property. (Crowley's larger Penn Terminals marine facility in nearby Eddystone is rail-served, but that is a separate site, idx 7.)
fieldNotes.streetView: truckGate pano 7vXBi7JM6OVZ0XwwnQVFyA sits at the south end of Delmar Drive (the closest public-road pano to the site driveway); perimeter interior has no Street View coverage (private lot).
